entries.en: Evelyn – I know where she is.
entries.ro: Evelyn – știu unde e.

entries.en: Evelyn's not at Clouds anymore.
entries.ro: Evelyn nu mai e la Clouds.

entries.en: V. You called, heh.
entries.ro: V. Ai sunat, heh.

entries.en: Didn't expect to hear from you again. Like, ever.
entries.ro: Nu mă așteptam să mai aud de tine. Pe bune, niciodată.

entries.en: Got a lead on Evelyn.
entries.ro: Am o pistă despre Evelyn.

entries.en: I don't give up that easy.
entries.ro: Nu renunț așa ușor.

entries.en: Don't know me, then. I don't hold grudges or forget promises just 'cause someone's havin' a shitty day.
entries.en_m: You don't know me, then. I don't hold grudges or forget promises just 'cause someone's havin' a shitty day.
entries.ro: Atunci nu mă cunoști. Nu țin ranchiună și nu uit promisiuni doar pentru că cineva are o zi nasoală.

entries.en: Sure went and proved it.
entries.ro: Și încă cum ai dovedit-o.

entries.en: Called me up just to say that?
entries.ro: M-ai sunat doar ca să-mi zici asta?

entries.en: Oh, shit...
entries.ro: Of, căcat...

entries.en: Headin' there now.
entries.ro: Mă duc acolo acum.

entries.en: Promised I would, didn't I?
entries.ro: Am promis că o să, nu?

entries.en: Know something that might interest you.
entries.ro: Știu ceva care te-ar putea interesa.

entries.en: Know where to find him?
entries.ro: Știi unde să-l găsești?

entries.en: Promised I'd call, didn't I?
entries.ro: Am zis că sun, nu?

entries.en: Got something concrete you'll wanna hear.
entries.ro: Am ceva concret pe care o să vrei să-l auzi.

entries.en: Promising's one thing, keepin' it's a whole other bag.
entries.ro: Una e să promiți, alta e să te ții de ce-ai zis.

entries.en: So, manage to learn anything?
entries.ro: Deci, ai aflat ceva?

entries.en: Well... I'm listening.
entries.ro: Păi... ascult.

entries.en: Headin' there now. To find her.
entries.ro: Mă duc acolo acum. S-o găsesc.

entries.en: Know where to find this Fingers character?
entries.ro: Știi unde-l găsesc pe Fingers ăsta?

entries.en: I told her to stay the fuck away from Clouds... Argh, all right. Later, V.
entries.ro: I-am zis să stea dracu' departe de Clouds... Argh, bine. Mai târziu, V.

entries.en: Yeah, runs a dinky chop-shop off Jig-Jig Street. Fuck, V, guy's all kinds of bad news.
entries.ro: Da, are un atelier de doi lei pe Jig-Jig Street. Pula mea, V, tipul ăsta aduce numai belele.

entries.en: Behavioral chip was damaged. 'Parently they carted her off to a ripperdoc goes by Fingers.
entries.ro: Cipul comportamental a fost avariat. Se pare că au dus-o la un ripperdoc pe nume Fingers.

entries.en: Got the virtu, Judy.
entries.ro: Am virtu-ul, Judy.

entries.en: Waitin' in the car. Just hurry up, OK?
entries.ro: Aștept în mașină. Grăbește-te, OK?

entries.en: Judy – hey. Just comin' out of Clouds. Evelyn was here. Had an accident.
entries.ro: Judy – hei. Tocmai ies din Clouds. Evelyn a fost aici. A avut un accident.

entries.en: What happened?
entries.ro: Ce s-a întâmplat?

entries.en: Can't say for sure. Ripper by the name of Fingers might have her. Heading there now.
entries.ro: Nu pot zice sigur. Un ripper, Fingers, ar putea s-o aibă. Mă duc acolo acum.

entries.en: I know the place. He runs a dinky chop-shop off of  Jig-Jig Street. Fuck! I told her not to go back…
entries.ro: Știu locul. Are un atelier de doi lei pe Jig-Jig Street. Băga-mi-aș! I-am zis să nu se mai întoarcă...

entries.en: Thanks for the call, V.
entries.ro: Mulțumesc pentru apel, V.
